description_en: Adds multiple Mongos or shard nodes to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 为云数据库MongoDB分片集群实例批量添加Mongos节点、Shard节点
name: CreateNodeBatch

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The source of the request. Valid values:
OpenApi: OpenAPI.
mongo_buy: The console
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源，取值说明：
OpenApi：请求来源为OpenAPI。
mongo_buy：请求来源为控制台
parameters.name: from_app

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: (Default) Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
false: Manual payment is enabled. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：

true：（默认值）自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
false：手动付费。具体操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the Mongos or shard nodes to be added. For more information about the specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html.

By default, a sharded cluster instance supports up to 32 Mongos nodes and 32 shard nodes
parameters.help_zh:
添加Mongos节点或Shard节点的规格信息。具体规格，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。

分片集群实例默认最多支持32个Mongos节点和32个Shard节点
parameters.name: nodes_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null: (Default) A coupon is used.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: No coupon is used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to apply for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node. Valid values:

true: Applies for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node.
false: (Default) Does not apply for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node
parameters.help_zh:
是否申请Shard节点直连地址，取值说明：

true：申请Shard节点直连地址。
false：（默认值）不申请Shard节点直连地址
parameters.name: shard_direct

parameters.help_en:
The name of the account. Valid values:

The name must start with a lowercase letter.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
The name must be 4 to 16 characters in length.

ApsaraDB for MongoDB does not support using keywords as account names.
The permissions of the account are fixed to read-only.
When you apply for a direct connection endpoint for a shard node for the first time, you must set the account name and password. You do not need to set them again for subsequent applications
parameters.help_zh:
账号名，取值说明：

以小写字母开头。
由小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
长度为4~16个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持使用关键字作为账号。
账号的权限固定为只读权限。
首次申请Shard节点直连地址时，需要设置账号和密码，后续申请无需再次设置
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the account. Valid values:
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=.
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

ApsaraDB for MongoDB does not support resetting the password of the account for a shard node
parameters.help_zh:
账号密码，取值说明：
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。
长度为8~32个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持重置Shard节点的账号密码
parameters.name: account_password

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the added Mongos or shard node
